offered_inputs.claim: The simulator launch seam accepts scout independently from the fixture transport.

server_state.claim: Offline account transport is synthetic. GOL starter text falls back locally; this story does not send a question. The separate GolChatUITests local journey verifies streaming and 402 with real Flask authentication and accounting.

preflight.note: The final-code checkpoint resolves every fixture request before URLSession and rejects unmatched paths.
